title: Automated Legal Deposition Indexing
problem: Manual review of long-form audio recordings to identify specific speaker contributions is time-consuming and prone to human error, leading to delays in case preparation.
solution: The GPT-4o Transcribe Diarize model automates the conversion of audio to text while simultaneously tagging segments with unique speaker identifiers, enabling structured transcripts that map dialogue to specific participants.
steps: Capture high-fidelity audio of the deposition session.
Submit the audio file to the Transcription API using the gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize model ID.
Receive the structured output containing text segments mapped to speaker labels.
Parse the diarized output to populate a searchable database for legal review.
outcome: Legal teams gain a searchable, chronologically accurate record of testimony that eliminates the need for manual transcription review.
limitation: The model may struggle with overlapping speech or high-noise environments, which can be verified by reviewing the confidence scores of the speaker segments in the output.
